about: The decomposition a planner would naturally arrive at for bench/fixture-large/brief.md: one issue per row, `needs` the issues that must land first, `modules` the hidden-test modules it is judged on. It is NOT given to any arm; test/test_bench_large.py checks that its size (30-40), shape (acyclic, at least 4 independent issues at one depth) and coverage (every module) stay what the fixture claims.
